name: System dynamics
description: Drag-and-drop mechanical systems, straight-line and turning: masses, inertias, springs, dampers, gears, levers, rack and pinion, force / torque sources, a link and a DC motor with gearbox. Shows the equations, the poles (natural frequency and damping ratio) and the time response. Bode, Nyquist, root locus and the optimiser come next.
